LanguageData.DeltaV_CargoStorageModeDesc: Click to switch modes. Storage: colonists haul items according to filters and priority, use stored ingredients, and move goods to higher-priority storage. Sealed: automatic deliveries stop, contents are held inside the container and cannot be hauled, and cargo is excluded from orbital trade beacon lists. To retrieve goods, unseal the bay and take some items, or open it to scatter all contents on the ground. Locked bays count as sealed; unlock them before switching modes or opening them.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeChanged: Trade cancelled: the docking link, cargo or terminal changed. Reopen trade to refresh the goods.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoRoom: Trade cancelled: stock or unlocked delivery cargo capacity is full. Free space and try again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeConfigureDesc: Choose a trader type and restock interval, and bind supply and collection cargo bays.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeConfigureHelp: Supply bays must be locked; collection must be unlocked. Configuration requires God Mode. Player facilities also require the terminal's Indiscriminate supply debug toggle to restock. Collection cargo is never refreshed.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeBindings: Cargo bindings (multiple supply bays, one collection bay)
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoKind: No valid trader type is configured.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoSupply: The terminal has no valid locked supply bay on its structure.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoDelivery: The terminal has no valid unlocked collection bay on its structure.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoDock: No ship with a player-owned primary console is soft or hard docked at this station.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeCargoDisconnected: The cargo bay must be on the terminal's connected substructure.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeDeliveryNeedsUnlock: Unlock this bay before assigning it for collection.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeSupplyNeedsLock: Lock this bay with its God Mode command before assigning it for supply.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeCargoAlreadyBound: This bay belongs to another terminal. Remove its previous binding first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeNoCargoOnMap: There are no cargo bays on this map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DevTradeRestock: DEV: Regenerate supply stock (replaces old stock)
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeCloseWindow: Close the trade window before regenerating stock.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeShipUnavailable: The selected source map no longer has an eligible docked player ship. Choose a cargo source again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DevTradeIndiscriminateSupplyDesc: Allow merchant stock to refresh in player facilities for station authoring and testing. Off by default. Applies to both periodic and manual restocking, and is saved with this terminal.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradePlayerSupplyBlocked: Player terminals and supply bays on player ships cannot receive merchant stock. Enable Indiscriminate supply on the terminal for testing.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeDevBuildOnly: Trade terminals can only be placed in God Mode.
LanguageData.DeltaV_TradeSourceHelp: Choose a ship's map as the cargo source. Ships sharing a map are grouped together. Goods and silver must be covered by powered player orbital trade beacons on that map. Purchases go to the station's collection bay; sales go to its supply bays.
LanguageData.DeltaV_CargoModeNoRoom: There is not enough room for the cargo. The mode change was cancelled. Clear loose items from the bay footprint first.
